name: security-credentialed-download-context-review
intent: Authenticated full and resumed downloads across redirects and delivery origins
artifacts: Download handler, authorization, Content-Type/Disposition, redirect chain, filename construction and consuming browser.
trace: Follow who can obtain the object and whether the delivered response executes attacker content in a privileged origin or leaks the protected object through a changed delivery path.
experiment: Using one owned synthetic object/version, compare authorized full download, authorized range/resume, and a restricted resumed/redirected request under the declared capability lifetime. Retain final recipient, credentials, 200/206 body and version validator.
disproof: A filename suffix or absent attachment header is not execution; an authorized download is not a confidentiality violation by itself.
repair: Bind download authority to the object and serve a deliberate safe origin/type/disposition; verify actual browser behavior and normal downloads.
branch_decisions: Separate first-party inline rendering, attachment handling and an isolated download origin. A blob URL may inherit a relevant origin; inspect its creation context. Validate sensitive object access before examining MIME behavior, and do not call authorized public active content a leak solely because it executes.
operational_method: Specialize in authenticated full versus Range/resume downloads across redirects and delivery origins. Retain the initial request, redirect chain, credential context, final 200/206 response, Content-Range and object version/validator. Compare an entitled full download with a restricted resumed request and the declared capability/revocation policy. A legitimate already-started transfer or signed capability lifetime is not automatically a bypass. Trace a delivered marker into its actual browser/download consumer; route generic upload execution and ordinary XSS to their respective workflows.
